Name: Replace Sebastian with Marty McFly
Author: KonaKona7
Description:
Portrait art borrowed and edited from:
http://canvas.pantone.com/gallery/83661265/PixelArt-Vol-IV-Back-to-the-Future

Pairs well with my other mod that replaces Demetrius with Doc Brown:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6365]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6365[/url]

The DeLorean came out a bit smaller than I would've liked, but unfortunately I couldn't do anything about that as I had to stay within
the space constraints of Sebastian's bike.

Does not change names or dialogue or anything besides graphics. If anyone wants to make those, feel free to do so with my blessing.

Straight XNB mod. Drag and drop Content folder into your Stardew Valley folder to install.

Replaces the following files:
Content\Characters\Sebastian.xnb
Content\Portraits\Sebastian.xnb
Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb
Content\Maps\sebastianMountainTiles.xnb
Content\Maps\fall_outdoorsTileSheet.xnb
Content\Maps\spring_outdoorsTileSheet.xnb
Content\Maps\summer_outdoorsTileSheet.xnb
Content\Maps\winter_outdoorsTileSheet.xnb


Future ideas:
Robin into Clara
Clint into blacksmith Doc
Maru into Jennifer
BttF in the movie theater (impossible at the moment because xnbcli does not support the new xnb formats from SDV1.4)
